quotes.speaker: Alan Hahn
quotes.summary_phrase: Alan Hahn on his physical state during the 2010 playoffs
quotes.excerpt: I wasn't able to do anything physically because I was exhausted, but it was a lot of fun.
quotes.quote: I can confirm, although this past June, I wasn't able to do anything physically because I was exhausted, but it was a lot of fun.

quotes.speaker: Alan Hahn
quotes.summary_phrase: Alan Hahn on breaking the LeBron James to Miami story
quotes.excerpt: It was a tweet. That was the problem. The Newsday wanted me to wait.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: You were one of the few that texted me a congratulatory, I know Woj said something as well, and it was always I knew it was the newspaper guys who got it, who cared that it was a newspaper guy who got it.

text_blocks.speaker: Alan Hahn
text_blocks.text: It was a tweet. That was the problem. The Newsday wanted me to wait, write the story, and we'll post the story. I said, hell no. If I'm hearing it and somebody else is going to hear it, I'm tweeting this thing.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst on the Knicks' pursuit of LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: Between 2003, where I was at the lottery, and the summer of 2025, the Knicks would have crawled.
quotes.quote: I honestly believe between 2003, where I was at the lottery, and the summer of 2025, the Knicks would have crawled over razor blades to get LeBron James. Some years maybe more than others, but obviously in 2008, when LeBron was 20 months from free agency, they started making trades to clear cap space.

quotes.speaker: Alan Hahn
quotes.summary_phrase: Alan Hahn on LeBron James's long-standing interest in the Knicks
quotes.excerpt: Our beautiful league is always more beautiful when the Knicks matter and the Garden is jumping.
quotes.quote: I actually kept this quote when Leon Rose was hired because it made me think, if it's ever going to happen, this is now what it's going to happen. And the quote was, our beautiful league is always more beautiful when the Knicks matter and the Garden is jumping. I think it's going to be great. That's what LeBron James said.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst on the Knicks' history of pursuing LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: This whole thing is one giant walk down memory lane here on storytime with SoFi.
quotes.quote: This whole thing is one giant walk down memory lane here on storytime with SoFi. Get your money right. Every year for 20-plus years, the Knicks, if they were given an opportunity to get LeBron James, would have taken him.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst on the Celtics' roster changes and outlook
quotes.excerpt: I believe the Celtics are going to be a regular season monster.
quotes.quote: I believe the Celtics are going to be a regular season monster. I don't know yet if I can believe their postseason. They've downgraded their top-end talent. I believe they have, maybe they don't agree. Maybe Paul George doesn't agree.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim MacMahon on the Celtics' decision to move on from Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: They don't think Paul George at this point is as talented as Jaylen Brown.
quotes.quote: Of course they agree they downgraded the top-end. They don't think Paul George at this point is as talented as Jaylen Brown. They just thought it was time for Jaylen Brown to go.

quotes.speaker: Alan Hahn
quotes.summary_phrase: Alan Hahn on Paul George's performance and role with the Celtics
quotes.excerpt: Right now, Paul George is a good starter and not going to be a finisher.
quotes.quote: Right now, Paul George is a good starter and not going to be a finisher. He runs out of gas in the second half of games. That's been sort of what we've seen from him. He gets off to hot starts, but it's finishing games that's maybe you won't even see him on the floor at times because they can run so many other bodies out there.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst on the Knicks' medical staff and Mitchell Robinson
quotes.excerpt: One of the things that the Knicks have gotten right is their medical staff.
quotes.quote: One of the things that the Knicks have gotten right is their medical staff. Their guys are healthier. I know that it was annoying to Mitchell Robinson last year that he sat certain games. I know that it was annoying to him going into free agency that it was the implication was that he was a player who was dealing with injury when he didn't feel that he was. But when it mattered, Mitchell Robinson was getting offensive rebounds.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst on Jalen Brunson's injury during the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: The fact that Jalen Brunson did that playoff run with a wrist that needed surgery.
quotes.quote: The fact that Jalen Brunson did that playoff run with a wrist that needed surgery. It would not surprise me if you see Jalen Brunson and Shai Gilgeous-Alexander get a few extra offensive fouls early in the season and this become like a story.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst on Ben Simmons's Achilles injury
quotes.excerpt: Disaster on Sunday, he tears his Achilles in practice.
quotes.quote: Disaster on Sunday, he tears his Achilles in practice and obviously out for the season and a terrible spot for that to happen. I'm sure he's devastated. He looked very healthy and his career has unfortunately largely been defined by injury.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst on Steph Curry's injury during a scrimmage
quotes.excerpt: Steph is out there just dribbling and in the middle of a play he just tweaked something.
quotes.quote: Steph is out there just dribbling and in the middle of a play he just tweaked something in his right leg and just like walked off. I think he went to the locker room. And it's worrisome because it was that right knee that cost him 27 games last year with that just severe tendinitis.
